caption: The video showcases a white tabletop scattered with many small cubic clusters of shiny metallic magnetic balls. At the left, a hand grips the near end of a diagonal bar that is already lengthening, its body shifting rightward while the far end sweeps upward toward a nearby cluster, growing the short slab into a much longer bar. The other cubic clusters remain largely in place. The elongated bar remains at the upper-left. A right hand appears at the upper-right, grasping a compact cluster and dragging it so the held end stays roughly in place while the opposite end stretches leftward into a new bar. This second stretching continues through the final frame.
